narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#5488 Prefer-A 6065040568)

1. Opt-in Stop-1 materiality-bar: ship-ready + closed utterance token; bare arc without token keeps non-empty all-accept.
2. LGTM conjunct: zero accepted blockers; zero unresolved blocker residuals; parent move-forward record; closed clean-result or footnote-only census; stub/blank/dispatch-fail refuse.
3. Under limb 2, waive empty-(a)/footnote-only at Path 1 and Path 2.
4. Closed synthesis lead admitted by evaluateCompletedArcRecord.
5. Under ship-ready, default unpromoted sharpens to footnote; LGTM relaxes finding-set only; reuse pain/audit/citation admission.
6. Yolo confirms non-empty all-accept only.
7. No auto-ingest.
8. Keep #5489 out.
9. Fixtures: stub / footnote-only / LGTM-complete / blocker-present / ship-ready-without-move-forward / yolo-alone.
10. Injection/swarm blockers stay blocking.

sentences: design-critique: allow a finished arc to mean “looks good to me”

Summary On the path teams actually run (`arc yolo noingest`, normal defaults), a successful design-critique arc cannot mean “looks good to me — nothing material to change.” A finished arc must accept one or more `blocks-the-design` or `sharpens-framing` findings.
Empty findings and footnote-only results cannot complete.
After real fixes, re-runs keep “succeeding” by emitting more polish items and accepting them.
Ask: Add a supported way for Arc to finish as move-forward / looks good to me when there are no material blockers — without weakening real defect handling, and without redefining `yolo`.
> Priority: normal.
Not an adoption blocker.
Not urgent for current efforts.
Ordinary product backlog.
Related: prior-run closed findings / diminishing returns → #5489 (filed together; ship this LGTM ticket first).
--- ## Background Design-critique Arc records a disposition over findings on a GitHub issue, then may stamp `design-critique:ingest-ready` after a completed-arc record.
That is the right tool when a proposal has real holes.

Teams also use Arc as a readiness gate: “Is this ticket good enough to implement?” After corrections, a valid answer is sometimes: yes — looks good to me. Today that is not a supported completion outcome.
Current rules (relevant) - Auto-finish (including under yolo) requires a non-empty set of blockers and/or sharpens, all `accept-into-contract` (no `defer`, no `disagree`).
Yolo only auto-confirms that all-accept map.
It does not allow empty or footnote-only completion.
Footnote-only can be recorded but cannot finish the arc.
Zero classified findings → halt; do not finish.
Manual “accept synthesis” also refuses empty / footnote-only.
So: “no material findings → move forward” is not a supported bind path.
`noyolo` helps humans challenge overreach before confirm.
It does not create a clean LGTM path.
--- ## Pain Seen while preparing a large install/upgrade redesign ticket (multiple Arc passes, then checked against current `content/contracts/design-critique.md`): 1.
Early passes found real blockers.
Fixes applied.
Good.
Later passes on the revised text still “succeed” by producing more `sharpens-framing` and all-accepting them under yolo.
Clean “looks good to me” never arrives after corrections.
Deferring polish blocks the yolo auto-finish path, so the easy path is to accept nits into the contract.
Big tickets may use a 3-critic panel, which makes the pile larger under the same “must accept findings to finish” rule.
`noingest` does not shrink the pile; it only delays ingest.
After a completed arc the skill still points at ingest next.
Net: Arc can finish, but it cannot win clean.
That is unlike ordinary review tools that can approve with zero findings.
--- ## Why this is a product gap Open critique + “classify findings” + “non-empty blockers/sharpens required to finish” rewards turning wording polish into `sharpens-framing`.
Yolo makes all-accept the path of least resistance.
Operators who want a ship gate must either keep accepting polish forever, or fight the tool.
That is bad default UX for teams using Directive.
--- ## Desired outcome Keep today’s strict path when there are real defects.
Add a supported completion equivalent to: > Looks good to me — no material blockers.
Move forward.
Requirements 1.
Available on the path people actually run (`arc` / `arc yolo noingest`), not only a hidden expert mode.
Zero material blockers (and footnote-only or empty material set) can complete when the parent records move-forward / LGTM.
Do not redefine `yolo`. Yolo stays “confirm all-accept.” LGTM / move-forward is a separate charter or Stop-1 materiality intent.
Do not waive real blockers. Any accepted `blocks-the-design` refuses LGTM completion.
Under ship-ready / LGTM intent, sharpens are non-blocking by default (defer or footnote) unless the operator promotes them.
No auto-ingest on LGTM.
Non-goals - Do not weaken injection/swarm rules on authority-changing targets.
Do not force N=1 for all arcs.
Do not solve prior-run “don’t re-litigate” memory here (separate companion issue).

--- ## Proposed shape (discussion, not locked API) Pick the smallest change that makes LGTM first-class, with fixtures: - A. Stop-1 / charter field: `materiality-bar: ship-ready` (opt-in token on the utterance, or documented default for readiness-gate arcs).
B. Bind path: when material blockers = 0, allow `design-critique: synthesis accepted, move-forward yes, material-findings none` (exact spelling TBD) and ready stamp.
C. Allow footnote-only completion when Stop 1 recorded ship-ready intent.
Prefer opt-in first if changing bare-arc default is too risky; document how readiness-gate arcs should invoke it.

--- ## Acceptance criteria (draft) - [ ] With ship-ready / LGTM intent recorded, an arc with zero accepted blockers (and no disposition-carrying sharpens, or sharpens deferred) can reach completed-arc + ready stamp.
[ ] An arc with any accepted `blocks-the-design` cannot LGTM-complete.
[ ] Bare yolo without ship-ready keeps today’s non-empty all-accept behavior (no silent break for existing arcs).
[ ] Thin skill / contract docs state when to use ship-ready vs full open critique.
[ ] Fixtures cover: stub vs footnote-only vs LGTM-complete vs blocker-present.
